name: Workshop Protocol (CPU, under an hour)
description: The basic protocol (AMBER Tutorial 33) shortened to 0.42 ns so a small solvated protein finishes on a laptop CPU inside a 3-hour workshop: 1000-cycle minimization, 20 ps heating, 100 ps NPT, 300 ps production. Measured end to end on a 3923-atom peptide box on a MacBook Air: 41 min with sander.MPI on 4 cores; expect about 75 min with serial sander. No GPU step.
author: Matthew J. Guberman-Pfeffer

steps.name: Energy Minimization
steps.description: 1000 cycles with the backbone restrained (10 kcal/mol·Å²).

steps.name: System Heating
steps.description: 0 to 300 K over 15 ps, then 5 ps at 300 K, backbone restrained (1.0 kcal/mol·Å²).

steps.name: NPT Equilibration
steps.description: 100 ps at 1 bar to settle the density, weak backbone restraints (0.1 kcal/mol·Å²).

steps.name: NVT Production MD
steps.description: 300 ps unrestrained, one frame per ps.
